## Beta Distribution

The beta distribution is commonly used as a prior for a probability parameter.

$$\theta \sim \operatorname{Beta}(\alpha,\beta)$$

## R Example

```{r}
#| echo: true

theta <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)

plot(theta, dbeta(theta, 10, 5),
     type = "l",
     xlab = "Theta",
     ylab = "Density")
```
